entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Sorry to pull you out of class, but it's[n]about Takase-kun's guardians...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I told them... that I'm not going[n]to pay them any more money!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm quitting my part-time job too![n]Although I'm still in talks with my[n]boss about it.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm going to devote myself to being a[n]great teacher! No matter what others[n]say, I won't waver.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So, thank you for giving me such[n]good advice.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I just thought you should be[n]the first to know...

entries.speaker: Female Teacher's Voice
entries.en: Ms. Kawakami, you have guests.[n]The Takases are here...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: They're here? At school...!?

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: How long are you gonna make us wait!?

entries.speaker: Takase's Female Relative
entries.en: Tch, him again?
We're talking here.
You know it, lady.

entries.speaker: Takase's Female Relative
entries.en: How rude...

entries.speaker: Takase's Female Relative
entries.en: I guess a student is only as good as his[n]teacher. Obviously you lack a proper[n]education.

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: You thought you could just call and say[n]you're not going to pay anymore? Who[n]do you think you are?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's what I decided, for Takase-kun's sake.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm going to make sure there won't be[n]any more students like him, who...

entries.speaker: Takase's Female Relative
entries.en: So you're just trying to get out of your[n]responsibility? I bet you don't even[n]care about Taiki!

entries.speaker: Takase's Female Relative
entries.en: How are you still a teacher? Maybe we[n]really should sue the Board of Education!

entries.speaker: Takase's Female Relative
entries.en: Are you okay with that? A teacher who[n]caused her student to die would surely[n]cause a scandal.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm not going to run or hide! I'm going[n]to spend my time taking care of my[n]students.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: If you want to take legal action,[n]then go ahead. Regardless, I'll [n]continue teaching.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I've decided that that's the best[n]apology I can make to Takase-kun.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Paying money to you two is not the[n]solution, to say the least!

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: Hmmm...

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: Along with suing you, maybe I should[n]tell everyone about your little secret...

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: ...You know. About your little stint[n]as a sex worker.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: How did you...!?

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: Oh? So I'm right, am I?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: I mean, the amount of money [n]you're paying us can't come[n]from just a teacher's salary.

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: Well? Shall we head on over to the[n]faculty office?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Stop... Please.

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: Hah! A teacher working in the[n]sex industry? You've definitely[n]done it this time.

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: How unfortunate for you that you[n]thought you could just leave Taiki's[n]matter unsettled...

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: You know what you have[n]to do now, right?

entries.speaker: Takase's Male Relative
entries.en: Pay up! And don't ever call us again[n]with this garbage about stopping the[n]payments!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Haha... I guess I can't quit my[n]part-time job just yet.
You can't give up.
But you were so determined.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I know!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But what am I supposed to do...?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: What about the Phantom Thieves...?[n]Would they even help someone[n]like me? No, that's impossible...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Haha...
Kawakami appears to be deeply hurting...
I need to do something for Kawakami...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I can't do this anymore...
What are their names again?
I need their names.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Who? The Takases?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: The husband is [clr 2]Toshio-san[clr 27]... [n]and his wife is [clr 2]Hiromi-san[clr 27]...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Haha, I could never forget them.[n]I send them money every week...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Wait, why? You don't intend on[n]doing something, do you?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Please don't. A Shujin teacher asking the[n]Phantom Thieves for help would be...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm sorry. I was so excited to tell[n]you what I had decided... and then[n]it ended up like this...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Just forget everything, okay?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: If you think about it, I'm right back where[n]I started...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...I guess I'll never be able to change.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Y-Yeah, haha...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Class is about to start... I need to go.
I need to do something about[n]the targets for Kawakami...
